notes.title: Small Update
notes.content:
In this update, we've added the following new challenge mode modifiers: 
Taboo Reinforcement, Snap, Arena, Firelight, Wood Release, Luck, Cheat, Great Serpent.

Additionally, we've optimized some memory leak issues.

notes.title: Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Bug Fixes

notes.title: Giant Update 1.5 (Important)
notes.content:
[b]【 New content added 】
1) We've added 4 new characters:[/b]
Sunder
Character Description:
Light exists only in faith, and the righteous burn their blood as pawns. She serves only her employer, "can't do" means "needs more money".
Skill Description:
[Blood Ignition]: Pressing the left mouse button immediately grants a Fire Element, with cooldown time of 4 seconds

Ming
Character Description:
Ming swallowed the relics of the Sixth Patriarch and transformed into a human. Later, he fed himself to demons, harboring [B-077 Sourceless Water], and was called the foremost leader of Zen Buddhism.
Skill Description:
[Waterflow Protection]: Pressing the left mouse button immediately sacrifices a Water Element, gaining 1  Stimulation and releasing a Water Ballon from the head, Water Balloon damage is linked to body length. with a Cooldown Time of 2 seconds

Serpheal
Character Description:
Under the influence of [A-058 God is a Girl], the serpent on the staff of the god of medicine turned into a girl, who dreams of creating omnipotent medicine, completely curing death.
Skill Description:
[Vegetation Whirl]: Pressing the left mouse button immediately eliminates 3 grass element orbs, changing the serpent's grass match-3 into revolving thorns</color> released on both sides, with a cooldown time of 1 second

Rainbow
Character Description:
Whenever the rain clears and the sun shines again, the immortal rainbow will once again span across the sky, forgetting all encounters and welcoming another rebirth.
Skill Description:
[Rainbow Origin]: Any element match-3 will leave behind an origin, which can be stimulated by a pulse to release again, with a maximum of 20 origins.

2) We've added 2 new Classes:
Light Wing: Enhance the effect of light wing and let light wing fly like a sword.
Thunder: Class unlocks the new Three elimination, combine fire fire, and light will release lightning, will increase the number of lightning.
3) We added a new game mode:
Challenge Mode: Add 3 positive or negative global effects to the difficulty level of Level 10 to increase replayability.

[b]【 Graphic Adjustment 】[/b]
1) Adjust the color of the fog to make the overall vision more harmonious.
2) Adjusted the icon and color of the treasure chest to increase the sense of unity.
3) Optimized the animation of treasure chests.
4) Added shadows for monsters, altars, skills, etc to improve visual performance.

[b]【 In-game Balance adjustment 】[/b]
1) Adjusted the balance of various classes.
2) Increased the rate at which boosts appear in chests.
3) Adjusted the base movement speed of some characters.
4) Speed up the movement of the monster and reduce the amount of blood of the monster.
[b]
【Bug Fixed 】[/b]
1) Fixed an invincible bug caused by Nuo
2) Fixed stuttering caused by the Ring of Fire.
3) Optimized grass skills that lead to stutters later in the game.
4) Built-in cooling is added to the pulse to prevent stalling caused by a large number of triggers.
-----------------------------------------------------
Feel free to check our new game! 
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2773600/_/]Picnic Peril
[/url]
Picnic Peril is a strategy game where your goal is to lure and stall ants to stop them from ruining your picnic. Combine the unique abilities of various foods to strategize and engage in a battle of wits with the ants! Go all out in this caloric colosseum!

notes.title: Small Patch Update 1.4~
notes.content:
1. The Moulting gain dice increases by one level and is changed to 2/3/5.
2. Increase the number of monsters with advanced levels 5-10
3. Increase the difficulty value of advancement 5-10. Now advancement 10 is a real challenge
4. Unify the performance of skipping the animation of opening treasure chests, upgrades, and events to the left mouse button/controller A button
5. Fixed the bug that missing elements for all the altars. To prevent the occurrence of similar bugs, we had to remove the "Try Again" button
6. Weakened the damage of Tengu

notes.title: Medium Patch Update 1.3 (Important)
notes.content:
[h1] Important Updates [/h1]
1. Optimized the difficulty progression system, the original maximum difficulty is 20, now adjusted to 10, and each player's advanced difficulty will be automatically divided by 2.
2. Further reduced the difficulty of playing in Advanced Level 0 and weakened the movement speed of monsters.
3. To provide a better experience of spawning monsters in the later stage, the density of monsters in the last 5 minutes of all difficulty levels has been increased. The higher the difficulty level, the more monsters there will be in the later stage.
4. Enhanced most of the weak buffs
5. Partially optimized the problem of excessive lag in the later stage. Now the performance pressure of fire and grass has become smaller.
6. The monsters Tengu and Nuomen are strengthened to cause multiple pieces of damage from elemental balls, which cannot be offset by light shields.
7. Modified the unlocking order of Prophecy genre and Focus genre
8. These changes will invalidate the "Continue Game" save and require a restart.

[h1]Bug fix [/h1]
1. Fixed the "Try Again" lag caused by the "Seal the altar within sight" event option.
2. Fixed the bug where the specific value of Moulting cannot be displayed.

[h1]Adjustment of Buffs and Moulting values[/h1]
[h2] Weaken [/h2]
1. Weakened the full-level number of buff dice 4 => 3, and also reduced the number of soul jade required to unlock it.

[h2] enhancement [/h2]
1. Buff [High Fever], the value increases after strengthening:
Damage +7=>+8

2. Buff [Steam], damage increased by 20%
Next damage +60%=>80%

3. Ability [Elemental Pulse] Base damage and range increase:
Damage 5=>6
Range 12=>14

4. Buff [Summon Golden Crow] Base damage increased:
Base damage 1=>2

5. Buff [Gluttony] Base value increase:
Body upper limit +2=>+3

6. Buff [echo] Adds additional effects:
Pulse size +20%

7. Buff [Amplification] Increase of stun time:
Vertigo time 1=>2

8. Buff [Paralysis] Damage increased:
Increased damage +200%=>300%

9. Buff [Divine Bird] Knockback distance increased:
Repel distance 1=>2

10. Buff [Swallowing Flames] Increased probability of obtaining fire element:
Probability of getting fire element from 10%=>20%

notes.title: Hey! We fixed some bugs!
notes.content:
Yo ！！！！ We're fixing bugs again!!
This time we are fixing ———————— Please check the following list!

1. Fixed an issue where the talent "Preheat" was incorrectly added during the secondary explosion
2. Fixed a bug where enhanced talents could prompt enhanced ones again
3. Fixed a bug that unlocked 15-minute achievements in the tutorial
4. Fixed the bug that time genre cannot be saved
5. Change the event option "Clear all elements" to "Block all altars within sight"
6. Fixed the problem that the soul jade cannot be saved internally when saving in the game

notes.title: Small patch update 1.1~
notes.content:
1. Fixed the problem that the talent interface could not display the value correctly, and optimized the description displayed when upgrading the talent.
2. Fixed the issue where the talent "Immovable" and the talent "Sly Maneuvers" were displayed incorrectly at the highest level.
3. Fixed the bug that caused the "Iron Persistence" failure!

notes.title: Small Update~
notes.content:
1. Fixed the "Try Again" frozen bug, please enjoy the game as you wish! 
2. Any character who clears a certain difficulty level can unlock the corresponding higher difficulty level for all characters. Achievements still require that character to complete the corresponding advanced difficulty level
3. Fixed the "Leap over the Dragon Gate" + Subway Station Number One" event unlimited damage bug, which will no longer cause you to suffer any damage!
4. Fixed a bug where invincible frames would get stuck in the "Lose all elemental orbs" event effect. Even if all the elemental balls are lost, there is no way to enter the invincible state!

notes.title: We apologize for the special bug, we are working on it! o(╥﹏╥)o
notes.content:
We are very sorry that some computers may get frozen after clicking the "Replay" button during play.
The bug is being urgently fixed in the application

Current solution:
Exit the game and re-enter, please do not click the "Replay" button when you play

If your computer does not have this problem, please continue the fight!
